not_covered.text: Saudi Arabia's air forces carries out an airstrike at a market in Taiz, Yemen, killing seven people and wounding 40 more.
Afghanistan forces kill 28 fighters allegedly associated with the Islamic State and capture another 32 from Pakistan.
A bus carrying Filipino tourists veers off a highway near Munich, Germany, killing two people and wounding 25 more.

Two giant pandas, Ping Ping and Fu Shuang, arrive at the Atlanta zoo from the Hartsfield–Jackson Atlanta International Airport in Atlanta, Georgia, U.S., as part of an agreement signed between the U.S. and China.
Five men are arrested in relation to a 'major incident' at RAF Fairford air base in England. They are arrested on suspicion of committing offences that violate the Explosives Act 1875.
The National Rally clears the 10-seat threshold in the Senate of France, allowing the party to meet qualifications for the formation of a far-right parliamentary group.
Citizens of São Tomé and Príncipe vote to elect 55 members of the National Assembly.
In tennis, the Czech Republic wins its 12th Billie Jean King Cup title and first since 2018 after defeating Ukraine 2–0 in the final in Shenzhen, Guangdong, China.
